name: alfaview-mcp
description: The plugin runs the alfaview MCP server and adds a skill for the tasks of an alfaview company.

author.name: alfaview Video Conferencing Systems GmbH & Co. KG

company_id.title: Company ID
company_id.description: The ID of your alfaview company.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The client ID of your alfaview API key.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your alfaview API key. Claude Code keeps it in its credential store, not in settings.json.

access_level.title: Access level
access_level.description: The tools that the server offers: read, standard or manage.

personal_data.title: Personal data
personal_data.description: With include, the results give every value. With omit, they leave out names, email addresses and the texts that people write about a meeting or a booking.

time_zone.title: Time zone
time_zone.description: The time zone of the times, the meetings and the emails, as an IANA name such as America/New_York. Empty: Europe/Berlin, also on a computer in another time zone.
